«auto» выбирает рабочий способ сам. uinp: "auto" picks a working method by itself. uinput emulates a keyboard at the kernel level and works in most applications. Choosing another backend makes sense only when a particular program has trouble with injection.

"Auto" corrects right away, "Manual" only on the hotkey, "Hybrid" decides by confidence.
«Авто» применяет уверенные исправления с: "Auto" applies confident corrections at once. "Manual" does not change text without the hotkey. "Hybrid" corrects only unambiguous cases automatically and leaves the rest to the hotkey. The T9 and punctuation options have their own switches and keep working in "Manual" mode when enabled separately.
«Исправить последнее слово» по умолчанию: "Fix the last word" is double Shift by default and works in manual mode too. "Undo the last correction" restores the previous text while the undo window lasts. "Switch the layout of the last word" flips the word into the other layout even when it looks correct. In hybrid mode double Shift also applies a pending suggestion, the one the auto-check did not dare apply itself; a separate key can be assigned for that. "Do not pass the hotkey to the application" swallows the press so it never reaches the active window.
«Как в системе» следует за оформлением р: "Follow the system" tracks the desktop appearance. "Light" and "Dark" force the scheme for the Klyrshift window. The theme does not affect word choice or text correction, only the look of the settings window.
«Пауза после Backspace» нужна для Chromi: The "Pause after Backspace" is needed for Chromium and Electron: they process Backspace asynchronously, and without a pause the first character is left over from the old word. The "Pause after the trigger" lets the application process the space or Enter before deletion. Values that are too large show up as lag, so raise them only when you hit a problem.

Обучение включено всегда и работает неза: Learning is always on and works quietly. It notices which words you leave alone, which you correct yourself and which edits you undo (Ctrl+Z or the undo hotkey). If you undid a correction, that word is left alone until the end of the session. A word you leave unchanged often enough enters the dictionary as "correct" and stops being corrected. The words themselves stay only in the daemon's memory and are never written to disk; only counters are kept (how many words were seen, corrected, rejected).
